きき.consejo: It is the basis of the "Por" and "Por": it is used with "Por."

かえった.es: (forma た de かえる) volví; habiendo vuelto

ばかり.consejo: Before a verb in the past means «I just...».

texto: Con la forma -ます sin ます + **ながら** dices que haces dos cosas **a la vez**: **おんがく を きき ながら** (escuchando música).
The two actions have to be of the same subject (made by the same person).

bloques.titulo: In the first place, the European Commission has been able to take action on the basis of the Commission's proposals.
texto: **Verbo en pasado + ばかり** indicates that, from the perspective of the speaker, the action occurred recently: **にほん から かえった ばかり です** (I have just returned from Japan). It does not fix how long «little» means; it depends on the context.
